testpoints.asserts: Registered MAC compute o_result<=(i_data*i_weight)+i_pre_result and data-forward o_data_next<=i_data across all four cells; verified end-to-end via the cycle-accurate RM matmul whose result propagates to o_prdata, compared every clk edge with 4-state ===.

Partial-sum chaining: top-row cells seeded with 32'h0 (pure multiply), bottom-row i_pre_result = top-row column partial sum; RM models the chain and the result read back over o_prdata is compared each clk edge with ===.
32-bit multiply/accumulate wraps modulo 2^32 (no saturation); RM computes the wrapped product/sum in 32-bit logic and the o_prdata read-back is compared each clk edge with ===.

Intentionally-unconnected mac_01/mac_11 o_data_next must not affect results; RM does not chain those forwards into any consumed signal, so the o_prdata read-back stays correct and is compared each clk edge with ===.

Systolic skew: out1=in1 delayed 1 cycle, out2=in2 delayed 2 cycles (delay20->delay21); RM reproduces the skew lines feeding the MAC array, and the resulting o_prdata read-back is compared each clk edge with === (proven [7,10,15,22] for SC-001).
Async active-low reset clears delay10/delay20/delay21 to 0; RM reset() zeroes the skew mirrors and post-reset predictions (propagating to o_prdata/counter/flags) are compared each clk edge with ===.
FIFO write on i_wr & !o_full into mem[wr_addr] with wr_addr advance; RM mirrors all three FIFOs' write path and the downstream o_prdata/o_full/o_empty predictions are compared each clk edge with ===.

Combinational FIFO read o_data=mem[rd_addr], rd_addr advances on i_rd & !o_empty, FIFO order preserved; RM models the read path and the o_prdata read-back word order is compared each clk edge with ===.

o_full and o_empty are INDEPENDENTLY PREDICTED by the RM per cycle (o_empty=(wr==rd), o_full=((wr+1)==rd) for all three FIFOs aggregated into the 3-bit {fr,f01,f00} buses) and the scoreboard COMPARES the RM prediction against DUT o_full/o_empty EACH CYCLE with 4-state === (each mismatch a uvm_error incrementing fail_count) — not mirrored from the DUT.

Write-while-full / read-while-empty ignored (pointer does not advance); RM guards writes with !full and reads with !empty, and the resulting o_full/o_empty/o_prdata predictions are compared each clk edge with ===.
Modulo-8 (3-bit) pointer wrap; RM uses 3-bit pointers so wr/rd wrap identically, and the o_full/o_empty/o_prdata predictions remain correct across the wrap, compared each clk edge with ===.

Async active-low reset clears FIFO memory and both pointers to 0; RM reset() zeroes all FIFO mirrors/pointers and post-reset o_empty (high) / o_full (low) predictions are compared each clk edge with ===.

APB weight load write_enb=i_psel&i_penable&i_pwrite -> mem[i_paddr]<=i_pwdata (clocked, no reset), address map W00=0..W11=3; RM mirrors the weight file (used by the MAC predict), and the resulting o_prdata read-back is compared each clk edge with ===. Rev 0.3: T-04/T-07 now run apb_weight_load FIRST so the read path never observes unwritten (X) weights.

APB read_enb=i_psel&i_penable&!i_pwrite -> o_prdata=fifo_result.o_data (combinational) advancing rd ptr, o_prdata=0 when no read; RM predicts o_prdata per cycle (read-back word vs 0) and the scoreboard compares against DUT o_prdata each clk edge with === (proven SC-001 read-back [7,10,15,22]). Rev 0.3: weights are loaded before this read in T-04/T-07 so the predicted result is deterministic (no X).

counter is INDEPENDENTLY PREDICTED by the RM per cycle (async reset->0; while start asserted counter[t+1]=counter[t]+1; when start deasserted counter[t+1]=0) and the scoreboard COMPARES the RM prediction against DUT counter EACH CYCLE with 4-state === (each mismatch a uvm_error incrementing fail_count) — sampled-and-compared, not just sampled.

fifo_en=start&(counter<2) pops both input FIFOs at counter 0,1; RM applies the same pop window to the input-FIFO read pointers, and the resulting o_prdata/o_empty predictions are compared each clk edge with ===.

result_fifo_wr=(counter in {2,3,4,5}); routing result_fifo_i_data=out1 at counter{2,4}, out2 at {3,5}, else 0 (out1=mac_10.o_result, out2=mac_11.o_result); RM reproduces the write window + counter-routed mux, and the o_prdata read-back of the routed words is compared each clk edge with ===.

done is INDEPENDENTLY PREDICTED by the RM per cycle as done=(counter>=5) (computed from the RM's own counter FSM, NOT mirrored from the DUT) and the scoreboard COMPARES the RM prediction against DUT done EACH CYCLE with 4-state === (each mismatch a uvm_error incrementing fail_count); observed done rises at counter=5 and drops on start deassert (re-run via SC-003).
